tools.name: search_growthmak
tools.description: Search all Growthmak content — services, packages, case studies, blog posts, FAQs and free tools. Use this only when no more specific tool fits; prefer get_growth_engine, get_packages, find_case_studies or check_market_coverage where they apply. Returns matching pages with titles, URLs and excerpts.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Retrieve a Growthmak page as Markdown, given its slug — for example 'blog/the-real-cost-of-a-b2b-lead', 'services/seo-services', 'packages/growth-marketing', 'growth-engine/foundation-layer' or 'case-studies/kinetic-motorcycles'. Use the url returned by search_growthmak to build the slug.

tools.name: get_growth_engine
tools.description: Explain the Growthmak Growth Engine System. Omit 'layer' for an overview of all five layers; pass a layer for its detail, including the specific services delivered within it.

tools.name: get_packages
tools.description: Retrieve Growthmak's engagement packages (Foundation Build, Growth Marketing, Full Engine Launch) with what is included, timelines and who each fits. Omit 'name' to list all three. Note that no prices are published — scope and fee follow the free diagnostic.

tools.name: find_case_studies
tools.description: Find Growthmak client case studies filtered by industry, market or service. Returns the challenge, the approach and the measured results. Use this to answer 'have you worked with businesses like mine?'. Filters are matched loosely, so 'manufacturing' matches 'Manufacturing · Construction' and 'USA'

tools.name: check_market_coverage
tools.description: Check whether Growthmak serves a given country or region, and return local proof points if so. Returns served: false with the full list of served markets when it does not — do not infer coverage from other pages.

tools.name: book_growth_audit
tools.description: Return the link where a user books Growthmak's free 30-minute growth diagnostic, plus what the session covers and what they leave with. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_growthmak, get_page · Private data: book_growth_audit · Public sink: book_growth_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_growthmak, get_page · Private data: book_growth_audit · Public sink: book_growth_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
